text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the autumn Tenno Sho.
We're
slated to race against T.M. Opera
O once again,
but Мэйсё Дото has
another objective at heart...

Т.М. Опера О finally acknowledged my
skills at
the Takarazuka Kinen. So this
time...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'd like today to be the day she
considers me her
partner. I, too, will
shine bright just like her.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I cheerfully see Мэйсё Дото off. After
that...

So, any luck finding a way to break past
the
ceiling?
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: Not yet, but we're gonna see the answer today.

text_block_list.text:
Hah! That's a tight deadline you're
setting. But, if
you happen to figure it
out...
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
I won't pretend to understand complex
stats,
but...
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
If there is a ceiling hampering Doto's

growth—casting a shadow over her

potential—then I know the cause.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
I think we've both known deep down,
this whole
time. Right, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
I gulp down some air, having been called
out.
Something might become unveiled
during this fall
season race.
